skill.name: react-async-patterns
skill.description: Guidance for finding and fixing async and await bugs in React, React Native, TypeScript, and Zustand code.
skill.summary: Review React async code for floating promises, race conditions, effect cleanup, and safer data-fetching patterns.

content.value_statement: Async React bugs create race conditions, missed state updates, and unreliable effects. This skill guides reviews, fixes, and lint rules for safer async code.
actual_capabilities: Identifies floating promise risks in TypeScript and TSX code reviews.
Explains post-condition validation after async state changes.
Compares sequential and parallel async execution with Promise.all.
Shows safe async patterns for React useEffect cleanup and AbortController.
Recommends TanStack Query for data fetching and mutation flows.
Provides ESLint rules for async promise correctness.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not execute lint checks by itself.
It assumes React, React Native, TypeScript, or Zustand context.
It does not replace runtime testing for timing-sensitive bugs.
It does not design full data fetching architecture beyond listed patterns.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Code
use_cases.description: Find floating promises, missed awaits, and unsafe ordering before a React feature ships.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Mobile Effects
use_cases.description: Apply cleanup and cancellation patterns to React Native screens that load async data.

use_cases.title: Create Async Review Standards
use_cases.description: Define lint rules and checklist items for teams that maintain TypeScript React apps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Async Code
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for one component or hook.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React component for async bugs. Find floating promises, race conditions, and missing post-condition checks. Suggest focused fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Effect Timing
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this useEffect flow. Explain where unmounts or dependency changes can race. Recommend cancellation or AbortController changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Zustand Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect these Zustand actions. Identify hidden async behavior, missing awaits, and state assumptions. Propose safer action signatures.

prompt_templates.title: Design Async Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a feature workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an async data flow for this React feature. Decide what should be sequential, parallel, or handled by TanStack Query. Explain tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: A component loads user data in an effect and sets state after navigation.
output: Identifies a race when the screen unmounts before the request finishes.
Suggests checking error paths before rendering dependent data.

output_examples.input: A Zustand action starts setup work and immediately updates feature state.
output_examples.output: The review flags hidden async behavior and recommends awaiting setup before state changes that depend on it.

output_examples.input: A reviewer wants lint guidance for promise correctness.
output: Uses no-misused-promises for unsafe async callbacks.

best_practices: Enable TypeScript ESLint promise rules before reviewing async code manually.
Validate state after critical loads before dependent actions continue.
Use AbortController or cancellation flags for effects that load data.
anti_patterns: Calling promise-returning functions without awaiting, returning, or documenting background execution.
Running dependent async steps inside Promise.all.
Making a useEffect callback async directly instead of wrapping the async work.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. It is a Markdown guidance skill with examples for grep searches and ESLint configuration.

faq.question: Can it help with React Native?
faq.answer: Yes. The async timing, cancellation, and state validation patterns also apply to React Native screens.

faq.question: Does it require Zustand?
faq.answer: No. Zustand examples are included, but most patterns apply to React hooks and TypeScript promises.

faq.question: Does it replace TanStack Query?
faq.answer: No. It recommends TanStack Query when manual async state management is risky or repetitive.

faq.question: Can it find every race condition?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure reviews, but runtime tests are still needed for timing-sensitive behavior.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
